title: Prelims study breakdown
notice: Derived study guidance. Every unit below groups or subdivides official syllabus lines; it never adds a requirement of its own.

prelims/paper-1.focus: One paper with ten sections. Seven of them cover all of India and Madhya Pradesh in parallel pairs; the last three — current events, ICT and tribes — are examined by recall rather than by depth, so treat them as revision material rather than as new reading.

prelims/paper-1/s1.focus: The widest section in the paper. Split it into the classical knowledge tradition, the medieval political record, and the modern freedom movement.

units.title: Ancient knowledge tradition and vocabulary
split: पुरुषार्थ, ऋण संस्कार, पंचमहायज्ञ/यज्ञ, कर्म का सिद्धांत
units.note: Learn these as terms with a one-line definition each; they recur as direct one-mark-style clues.

units.title: Ancient and medieval India: features, events, administration
units.note: Keep a single running timeline and hang administration, society and economy off it.

units.title: Cultural heritage: art, literature, festivals
units.note: Overlaps the art-and-culture material; study once and revise from the same notes.

units.title: Socio-religious reform movements
match: 19वीं एवं 20वीं शताब्दी में सामाजिक तथा धार्मिक सुधार आंदोलन
units.note: Organise by reformer, region, organisation and the practice each movement attacked.

units.title: Freedom struggle and the national movement
match: स्वतंत्रता संघर्ष एवं भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन
units.note: Phase it by 1885-1905, 1905-1919, 1919-1939, 1939-1947 with the session and leader for each phase.

units.title: Post-independence integration and reorganisation
match: स्वतंत्रता के पश्चात् भारत का एकीकरण एवं पुनर्गठन
units.note: Link this forward to the States Reorganisation material in Prelims Paper I subject 5 and Mains Paper I Unit IV.

prelims/paper-1/s2.focus: Madhya Pradesh's own history, culture and literature — the section where state-specific recall decides marks.

units.title: Dynasties and landmark events
match: मध्यप्रदेश के इतिहास की महत्त्वपूर्ण घटनाएँ
units.note: Build a dynasty-by-dynasty table: region ruled, capital, notable ruler, notable monument.

units.title: Role in the freedom movement
match: स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में मध्यप्रदेश का योगदान
units.note: Pairs with the tribal-heroes material in Mains Paper I Unit V.

units.title: Art and architecture
match: मध्यप्रदेश की प्रमुख कला एवं स्थापत्य कला
units.note: Tie each art form to the place it is practised in.

units.title: Tribes and their dialects
match: मध्यप्रदेश की प्रमुख जनजातियाँ एवं उनकी बोलियाँ
units.note: Studied in full in subject 10 of this paper — keep one set of notes for both.

units.title: Festivals, folk music, folk arts and folk literature
match: मध्यप्रदेश के प्रमुख त्योहार, लोक संगीत
units.note: Group by folk form and the community or region associated with it.

units.title: Authors and their works
match: मध्यप्रदेश के प्रमुख साहित्यकार एवं उनकी कृतियाँ
units.note: Learn as author-work pairs, with the language and period noted.

units.title: Religious, cultural and archaeological tourism sites
match: मध्यप्रदेश के प्रमुख धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक एवं पुरातात्विक पर्यटन स्थल
units.note: Map-based recall works best; mark each site on a blank MP outline.

units.title: World heritage sites
units.note: Small, high-yield list — also appears in Mains Paper I Unit IV.

units.title: Tribal personalities
units.note: Overlaps the freedom-movement material in subject 2 of this paper.

prelims/paper-1/s3.focus: Physical and human geography of India. The English rendition of this section is only partly present in the source, so the Hindi lines are the complete record.

units.title: Relief and drainage
match: पर्वत, पहाड़ियाँ, पठार, नदियाँ और झीलें
units.note: Anchor everything on a physical map: ranges, plateaus, river systems and lakes.

units.title: Climatic phenomena
units.note: Learn each phenomenon as a mechanism plus its effect on the Indian monsoon.

units.title: Natural resources
units.note: Distribution matters more than definition here.

units.title: Crops, food security and the green revolutions
units.note: Keep crop, season, leading producing state and the policy programme together.

units.title: Energy sources
match: ऊर्जा के पारंपरिक और गैर-पारंपरिक स्रोत
units.note: Same heading appears in subject 4 (Madhya Pradesh); study the MP examples separately.

units.title: Hazards, disasters and cyclones
match: भारत में प्राकृतिक खतरे और आपदाएँ
units.note: Expanded considerably in Mains Paper I Part B Unit IV — use that version for depth.

units.title: Population
match: जनसंख्या वृद्धि, वितरण एवं घनत्व, ग्रामीण-नगरीय प्रवास
units.note: Distinguish growth, distribution, density and migration as four separate ideas.

prelims/paper-1/s4.focus: Madhya Pradesh's physical and economic geography. Read it against subject 3 to see which India-level headings the state repeats.

units.title: Forests, forest produce and relief
match: वन, वनोपज, नदियाँ, पहाड़ियाँ और पठार
units.note: Know the forest types, the division-wise produce and the major river systems.

units.title: Climate
units.note: Compare with the India-level climate heading in subject 3.

units.title: Soils and minerals
units.note: Mineral belts and their districts are the highest-yield part.

units.title: Crops, water and irrigation
units.note: Learn the major irrigation projects by river and district.

units.title: Energy in Madhya Pradesh
match: ऊर्जा के पारंपरिक और गैर-पारंपरिक स्रोत
units.note: The state's thermal, hydro and renewable capacity and locations.

units.title: Industry
units.note: Industrial regions and the anchor units in each.

units.title: Population and urbanisation
match: जनसंख्या वृद्धि, वितरण एवं घनत्व, नगरीकरण
units.note: Note that subject 3 says migration where this one says urbanisation.

prelims/paper-1/s5.focus: Constitutional order, with the state layer attached. Learn the national framework first, then the Madhya Pradesh version of each institution.

units.title: The Constitution and its making
units.note: Pair with the constitutional-development material in Mains Paper II Part A Unit I.

units.title: Union executive and legislature
units.note: Powers, election, tenure and the relationship between the two.

units.title: Judiciary
units.note: Jurisdiction, judicial review and the writ structure.

units.title: Amendments
units.note: Learn only the landmark amendments with their subject.

units.title: Rights, duties and directive principles
units.note: Keep the three lists distinct; the overlap is a common trap.

units.title: Commissions and statutory bodies
units.note: Article, composition, tenure and function for each body.

units.title: Madhya Pradesh's constitutional order
units.note: Expanded in Mains Paper II Part A Units IV and V.

units.title: Panchayati Raj and urban administration
units.note: The three tiers, their elections and finances, plus the urban bodies.

units.title: Good governance
units.note: Administrative reform, transparency and service delivery in the state.

prelims/paper-1/s6.focus: Economy of India with Madhya Pradesh placed inside it. Roughly half the section is state-specific.

units.title: Madhya Pradesh's place in the Indian economy
match: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था में मध्यप्रदेश की वर्तमान स्थिति
units.note: Know the state's share in output and its sectoral composition.

units.title: Population and human resources
match: मध्यप्रदेश की जनसंख्या व मानवीय संसाधनों
units.note: Keep the indicator values for each of the three.

units.title: Sustainable development goals
match: सतत् विकास लक्ष्यों में मध्यप्रदेश की प्रगति
units.note: Links to the SDG heading in subject 7 of this paper.

units.title: Agriculture, industry, MSME and infrastructure
units.note: Study as four separate but connected sectors.

units.title: Self-reliant Madhya Pradesh and ODOP
units.note: The district-product pairing is a favourite recall item.

units.title: Intellectual property rights
units.note: Repeats in Mains Paper III Part A Unit IV.

units.title: Recent trends in the Indian economy
units.note: Keep the trend and its latest data point together.

units.title: Financial institutions
units.note: Regulator versus participant is the useful distinction.

units.title: Foreign trade policy and groupings
match: भारत की विदेशी व्यापार की नीतियाँ
units.note: G-20, SAARC and ASEAN — also revise them with current affairs.

prelims/paper-1/s7.focus: Science, environment and health in one section. Separate the scientific content from the scheme and programme content.

units.title: Branches of science
units.note: Definition and one example per branch is enough.

units.title: Indian scientific institutions
units.note: Learn institute, location and what it is known for.

units.title: Space and satellite technology
units.note: Match the mission or satellite to its purpose.

units.title: Human body and nutrition
match: पोषण, आहार, पोषक तत्व एवं कुपोषण
units.note: Organ systems, then nutrients and the deficiency each causes.

units.title: Genetic disease and sickle cell anaemia
units.note: The programme element makes this a state-scheme question as much as a science one.

units.title: Health policy, programmes and communicable disease
units.note: Overlaps the national health programmes in Mains Paper III Part B Unit IV.

units.title: Sustainable development and the SDGs
units.note: Pairs with the MP progress heading in subject 6.

units.title: Environment, ecology and biodiversity
units.note: Definitions and Indian examples for each.

units.title: Pollution and disaster management
units.note: Keep pollutant, source, effect and control measure together.

prelims/paper-1/s8.focus: Current events at three levels. This section cannot be finished once — it has to be revised on a cycle.

units.title: International current events
units.note: Keep a running month-wise file; revise monthly rather than attempting to memorise once.

units.title: National current events
units.note: Focus on policy, institutions and appointments that connect to a static topic.

units.title: Madhya Pradesh current events
units.note: State schemes, indices and appointments; the highest-yield of the three for this paper.

prelims/paper-1/s9.focus: Information and communication technology, from the very basic to the applied.

units.title: Computer fundamentals
units.note: Hardware, software, memory and the terms that go with them.

units.title: Electronics and ICT
units.note: Communication technologies and their everyday applications.

units.title: Robotics, artificial intelligence and cyber security
match: रोबोटिक्स, आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलीजेन्स एवं सायबर सिक्यूरिटी
units.note: Learn each as definition, application and the risk it carries.

units.title: E-governance
units.note: Repeats in Mains Paper III Part B Unit II; a few flagship portals are worth knowing.

units.title: Internet and social networking platforms
units.note: Basic internet terminology and the platforms named in current affairs.

prelims/paper-1/s10.focus: Tribes of Madhya Pradesh — heritage, folk culture and folk literature. The most state-specific section of the paper.

units.title: Distribution and constitutional provisions
match: मध्यप्रदेश में जनजातियों का भौगोलिक विस्तार
units.note: Map the tribal belt district-wise, then the constitutional safeguards.

units.title: Major, particularly vulnerable and nomadic tribes; welfare schemes
split: विशेष पिछड़ी जनजातियाँ एवं घुमन्तू जातियाँ
units.note: The PVTG list and the welfare schemes are the highest-yield parts.

units.title: Tribal culture
units.note: Study alongside the folk art and festival headings in subject 2.

units.title: Contribution to the freedom movement, personalities, institutions
match: मध्यप्रदेश की जनजातियों का भारत के स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में योगदान
split: स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में योगदान एवं राज्य के प्रमुख जनजातीय व्यक्तित्व
units.note: The tribal heroes here are named individually in Mains Paper I Unit V.

units.title: Folk culture and folk literature
match: मध्यप्रदेश की लोक संस्कृति एवं लोक साहित्य
units.note: Keep one consolidated folk-culture file across subjects 2, 10 and Mains Paper II Part B Unit V.

prelims/paper-2.focus: General aptitude. Every item here is a skill rather than a body of facts, so it is trained by timed practice rather than by reading — and item 7 is tested in Hindi only.

units.title: Comprehension and communication skill
units.note: Practise passages against the clock; accuracy and speed have to rise together.

units.title: Reasoning, decision making and mental ability
units.note: Three separate item types — track your accuracy per type rather than overall.

units.title: Basic numeracy and data interpretation
units.note: Charts, graphs, tables and data sufficiency; the source sets the level at about class ten.

units.title: Hindi language comprehension
units.note: Tested through Hindi passages only, with no English translation. Practise in Hindi.

connections.note: The constitutional framework is examined as objective recall in Prelims and as descriptive analysis in Mains; one set of notes can serve both.
Both carry Madhya Pradesh folk culture and tribal society — study them as one block.

revisionGroups.title: Everything specific to Madhya Pradesh
revisionGroups.note: Revise as a single state-specific block before the prelims; these four sections share facts and should not be revised in isolation.

revisionGroups.title: Environment, health and disaster material
revisionGroups.note: The same ecology, pollution and health material appears at Prelims and in Mains Paper III; revise the topics once, at Mains depth.
